data.name: Mahnoorah
data.gender_notes: Mahnoorah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'ah-naw-rah', meaning 'radiant' or 'shining'. In Islamic tradition, the moon represents tranquility, peace, and calmness, making Mahnoorah a beautiful name for a girl. It evokes images of a serene and illuminated night, filled with the gentle light of the moon. The name Mahnoorah carries the meaning “Moon-lit night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahnoorah usually hope their child will grow to embody moon-lit night and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with peace and tranquility, inspired by the calming presence of the moon.
data.etymology: Mahnoorah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon-lit night.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahnoorah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahnoorah epitomizes the beauty and serenity of the Islamic culture. The moon is an important symbol in Islamic art and literature, often representing peaceful and calm nights. The name adds an essence of tranquility and grace, fitting well within Islamic artistic traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mahnoorah lies in its roots, 'ah-naw-rah'. The word 'naw' in Arabic stands for 'resemblance of', showing the inner radiance and light present in those who bear this name. This idea of embodied brilliance is deeply spiritual, as it reflects the Divine Light that permeates all of creation and reflects His divine beauty within us. The spiritual resonance of this name unites the inner and outer dimensions of being, urging us to seek and reveal our own inner radiance mirroring the Divine Light.
